paragraphs.text: The metadata proposition remains unsupported because no actual audit has been collected, but a complete successful audit provides a positive route under the selected scope. Both root versions must match and every applicable reachable requirement must pass after extra propagation reaches a fixed point. That inference depends on the host binding the execution to the selected image and on the implementation faithfully enumerating the directory and dependency closure. The decisive next step is to qualify and bind the specified audit before collecting N1. D1 remains open because a returned coverage flag cannot itself exclude omitted requirements.

paragraphs.text: The broader runtime target remains conditional on separate runtime evidence because metadata consistency does not demonstrate successful imports or API behaviour. It requires the metadata predicate together with successful execution of an operator-defined smoke-test workload in the same image and an assessment that the workload supports only that limited target. Neither the workload nor its results are available, and scientific causal validity remains outside both claims.
